practical: Demonstration of Eddy Current testing principle using non-conductive and conductive samples; Safety precautions regarding high voltage and electrical grounding; Instructor supervision during coil coupling and signal interpretation
intro_questions: List the three main types of NDT methods covered in this course.
Define the basic principle of electromagnetic induction.
State the relationship between electrical conductivity and eddy current generation.

Describe the function of the reference standard in calibrating an eddy current system.
Differentiate between absolute and differential probe applications.
